% ========================== SELECTED PROJECTS ============================
% Grouped by research problem; publication entries on page 2 remain concise.
\cvsection{Selected Research Projects}
% Results below retain the paper's evaluation protocol; see EDITORIAL_NOTES.md.
\project{Agent DAgger: learning from on-policy experience}{First author\sep Preprint, 2026}
\begin{cvitems}
  \item Developed teacher-interleaved rollouts that combine on-policy state coverage with dense expert supervision, reducing covariate shift in long-horizon LLM agents.
  \item Achieved \textbf{27.3\% / 29.8\%} task resolution with 4B / 8B students on \mbox{SWE-bench Verified}, improving over on-policy distillation by \textbf{3.9 / 3.6 percentage points}.
\end{cvitems}

\project{Controllable reasoning: Matryoshka Pilot and EDO}{M-Pilot: co-first author, NeurIPS 2025\sep EDO: first author, TMLR 2026}
\begin{cvitems}
  \item Introduced \textbf{M-Pilot}, a lightweight white-box controller that steers black-box LLMs through intermediate guidance for multi-turn reasoning, planning, and personalization.
  \item Integrated exploration objectives into iterative DPO and GRPO with \textbf{EDO} to preserve solution diversity, improve test-time reasoning, and stabilize post-training.
\end{cvitems}

\project{DREAM: agentic evaluation of deep-research agents}{Co-first author\sep ACL 2026, Oral}
\begin{cvitems}
  \item Developed an \textbf{agentic evaluation framework} combining tool use with \mbox{query-agnostic} and adaptive metrics to assess factual accuracy, temporal validity, and reasoning quality.
\end{cvitems}
